|lore=Feisty. Loyal. Heroic. Insecure. Rebel spy. Excels at trouble. Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher. Has picked up a slight flutter. A bit eccentric.
|game_text=While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E4 (version 5 of 7) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current text; the current text is [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (Errata 6)]] (PC-E6). The image is the Players Committee card image of this text ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E3.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E3-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E2.gif]], 14 October 2020) → [[File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E3-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2-PC-E3.gif]], 27 November 2021). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E2”, but this is errata 4 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V)]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-r2022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual1-Light/large/r2d2.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier, in Virtual Set 1). Deploy 3, forfeit 4. Document: no errata mark; margin “•R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)”. Text: “While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. Immune to Fire Extinguisher.”
